title: Long Range Frequency Tuning for QML
summary: Angle-encoded variational quantum circuits admit a truncated Fourier series representation of their output, but approximating functions with maximum frequency $ω_{\max}$ using fixed unary encoding requires $\mathcal{O}(ω_{\max})$ encoding gates. Trainable-frequency (TF) circuits promise a reduction by learning the data-encoding prefactors alongside the ansatz parameters, adapting the accessible frequency spectrum to the target during training.
